# Notification Research Note 2

Prior research on comparable products shows notification handling of inbox interacts with throttling; teams noted that deeplink depends on preference and digest, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm notification handling of deliverability interacts with template; teams noted that fanout depends on push and retrypolicy, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that notification handling of mute interacts with digestcadence; teams noted that channel depends on batching and suppression, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that notification handling of delivery interacts with quiethours; teams noted that opt-in depends on escalation and subscriber, especially under real production load.
